agenda_strip.lock_title: Constitutional order — cannot be reordered or removed · Art. II §2; §7
art4_section5_tracker.action_refused: The action was refused. Please retry.
art4_section5_tracker.applied_body: {name} is edited to the text above; a new law version is published with the prior version retained in history.
art4_section5_tracker.empty_body: When a court issues a finding under Art. IV §5, this tracker shows the finding, the recommended remedy, both clocks (CLK-11 / CLK-12), and the three resolution paths live.
art4_section5_tracker.empty_title: No constitutional challenge is open in your jurisdictions
art4_section5_tracker.enforce_body: Enforcement aligns to the final state of the law: amended, upheld by override, or edited by the court.
art4_section5_tracker.enforce_title: Executives enforce the outcome — whichever path resolves
art4_section5_tracker.filed_by: by {who} — any inhabitant may file; no standing gatekeeper beyond jurisdictional association.
art4_section5_tracker.finding_gate: A finding is recorded while the challenge is under review (Art. IV §5.2).
art4_section5_tracker.full_court: the full court — all {n} judges · CLK-16, {judge} writing.
art4_section5_tracker.opt_contradiction_: A contradiction is found (opens the remedy step)
art4_section5_tracker.override_gate: A supermajority override opens while the legislative window is open, within the veto window (Art. IV §5.4).
art4_section5_tracker.override_gloss: Supermajority of all serving members — not just those present — recorded within the veto window.
art4_section5_tracker.override_meter_lab: Override — votes in favor of all serving
art4_section5_tracker.overruled_body: The law stands as written; the finding, the override vote, and every member’s position are on the public record.
art4_section5_tracker.panel_court: a severity-scaled panel of the {court}, {judge} writing.
art4_section5_tracker.path_a_body: The legislature modifies or removes the law through the ordinary bill flow within the judicial timeframe.
art4_section5_tracker.path_a_cite: due within {days} days of the finding · {clk} · Art. IV §5 — opinions remain commentary on the law as edited
art4_section5_tracker.path_a_h: Path A — Legislature modifies or removes
art4_section5_tracker.path_b_h: Path B — Supermajority override in the veto window
art4_section5_tracker.path_c_body: If the window closes with neither amendment nor override, the judiciary applies its remedy directly to the law’s text. Version history is preserved.
art4_section5_tracker.path_c_cite: opinions remain commentary on the law as written or edited · Art. IV §5
art4_section5_tracker.path_c_h: Path C — Window closes, judiciary edits the law
art4_section5_tracker.paths_group_aria: The three Art. IV §5 resolution paths
art4_section5_tracker.rationale: Why this makes the law non-contradictory
art4_section5_tracker.recommend_gate: A remedy is recommended after a contradiction is found (Art. IV §5.3).
art4_section5_tracker.recommend_h: Recommend the remedy and set the windows
art4_section5_tracker.recorded_notice: Recorded on the public register — the tracker reflects the new state.
art4_section5_tracker.remedial_bill_gate: A remedial bill is proposed while the legislative window is open (Art. IV §5.3).
art4_section5_tracker.remedy_gate: Available once both the remedy timeframe and the veto window have closed; the CLK-11 sweep applies it automatically otherwise (Art. IV §5.5).
art4_section5_tracker.stage_gloss: The finding lands on the legislature as a mandatory session priority — constitutional matters precede the general agenda (WF-LEG-05).
art4_section5_tracker.window_banner_body: The legislature has {days} days to modify or remove the law (CLK-12, due {due}) and {vetoDays} days to override ({clk}).
ballot_receipt.self_audit: Self-audit in the public count record
ballot_receipt.shown_post: . Copy it now — it is never retrievable later, by you or by anyone.

case_lifecycle.walkthrough_gloss: Back and Advance move through the sequence — simulation only.

cgc_governors.no_appointments: No governor appointments are recorded on this page.

cgc_governors.nominee_requirement: The nominee must have an active association with this jurisdiction. The engine assigns an available governor seat.
cgc_governors.role_preview_body: Explore this board’s appointments and legislative consent records.
cgc_governors.search_failed: The nominee search could not be loaded. Try again.

constituent_consent_panel.act_fails: The act fails — {which} did not clear the threshold
constituent_consent_panel.bodies_eyebrow: Constituent jurisdictions: supermajority of the bodies
constituent_consent_panel.body_vote_note: each constituent legislature votes as a body — its own chamber-vote record linked above
constituent_consent_panel.both_cleared: Both supermajorities cleared — the act is adopted
constituent_consent_panel.gloss: Both meters must clear their threshold — the legislature’s own supermajority and a supermajority of the constituent jurisdictions, each counted independently.
constituent_consent_panel.open_both: Open — both supermajorities must clear, each counted independently
constituent_consent_panel.table_caption: Constituent consents — each constituent legislature votes as a body
department_card.cgc_public_domain: — CGC IP perpetually public domain · Art. III §5
department_card.codet_parity_cite: {n} workers · worker seats equal owner seats · CLK-14
finalist_line.text: finalist line — top {count} advance to the ranked ballot · CLK-21
judicial_confirmations.none_recorded: No judicial nominations have been recorded for this court.
judicial_confirmations.role_preview: Role preview: members of this court’s source legislature review nominees and vote on confirmation.
judicial_confirmations.title: Judicial nominations and confirmation
judicial_nominations.authorization_note: Authorization opens a separate confirmation vote in the legislature that created this court. Review each person’s public profile before proposing or voting.
judicial_nominations.committee_intro: Any serving member of the designated judicial committee, including its chair, may propose a person. The committee must authorize the nomination by supermajority.
judicial_nominations.constituent_intro: A serving member of the seat’s constituent legislature may propose a person. That legislature must authorize the nomination by an ordinary majority of all serving members.
judicial_nominations.designate_note: The creating legislature assigns this responsibility through a recorded supermajority act.
judicial_nominations.designate_preview: Public preview: a serving member of the creating legislature files this proposal.
judicial_nominations.designate_summary: Designate or change the judicial committee
judicial_nominations.manage_committees: Create or manage this legislature’s committees →
judicial_nominations.no_committees: No eligible committees are available on this page. Create a committee, then return here to designate it.
judicial_nominations.no_matches: No matching people with an active association in this court’s jurisdiction.
judicial_nominations.no_proposals: No nomination or committee-designation proposals have been filed here.
judicial_nominations.no_vacant_seats: No vacant seats are available on this page.
judicial_nominations.proposal_failed: The proposal could not be filed. Please retry.
judicial_nominations.proposal_filed: Proposal filed. Follow its vote below.
judicial_nominations.search_failed: Search could not be loaded. Please retry.
judicial_nominations.seat_preview: Public preview: a serving member of this seat’s nominating body files the proposal.
juror_screening.clean_body: You remain in the panel pool. Empanelment is confirmed at voir dire.
juror_screening.flagged_body: A panel judge follows up on the answers you flagged. If a conflict is confirmed you are excused without penalty and the draw selects a replacement.
juror_screening.honesty: Answer honestly — screening removes conflicts of interest, never opinions, demographics, or politics. Your answers go to the panel judges only.
order_scope_card.emergency_scope: emergency methods widen the delegated scope only within the declared area and duration · Art. II §7 · CLK-03
order_scope_card.rejected_never_took_eff: The order never took effect; the rejected attempt is on the public record.
ownership_panel.cgc_body: In a Common Good Corporation the Board of Governors stands where shareholders would — the owner side runs on the share system everywhere else.
ownership_panel.no_stakes: No ownership stakes on record for this structure.
ownership_panel.rule_equal_partnership: Partnership changes require unanimity of partners.
ownership_panel.rule_member_owned: Member-owned — changes follow the membership’s own adopted rules.
ownership_panel.rule_nonprofit: Nonprofit — no ownership stakes; the board governs per its charter.
ownership_panel.rule_partnership: Changes proceed by the partnership agreement’s own consent rule.
ownership_panel.rule_stock: Owner consent counts voting shares — the share register decides.
ownership_panel.rule_worker_owned: Worker-owned — the worker-members are the owner side.
panel_table.caption: Panel assignment and conflict screening results
panel_table.gloss: Severity scaling: the heavier the possible consequence, the more judges must hear it — the panel is always odd so no case can deadlock.
phase_banner.frozen_cutoff: Standings below are the frozen cutoff.
phase_banner.open_locked_title: The approval phase has closed — finalists are locked.
phase_banner.profile_frozen_title: The approval phase has closed — this standing is frozen at the finalist cutoff.
phase_banner.profile_is_finalist: This candidate is a finalist on the ranked ballot.
phase_banner.profile_not_finalist: This candidate did not reach the finalist line and remains write-in eligible.
phase_banner.reg_closed_title: The finalist cutoff has passed for the current race.
phase_banner.reg_open_body: The approval phase is live — validated candidates appear on the open ballot immediately.
phase_banner.reg_reopens: registration reopens for the next cycle the moment results certify.
phase_banner.reg_tabulating_lead: Tabulation and certification are under way;
seat_map.chamber_aria: Circular chamber seat map — {seats} seats, {serving} serving
seat_map.legend: Gold ring = Speaker · dashed = vacant · blue ring = type B (one per constituent) · Art. V §3
seat_map.seat_vacant: Seat {n} — vacant (countback running); joins at the junior-most position
vote_cast_list.absent_title: Counts the same as a no — peg quorum (Art. II §2)
vote_cast_list.published_with_vote: published with the vote · Art. II §2
vote_tally.bicameral_peg_extra: Each kind meets its own peg quorum — vacancies stay in the denominator.
vote_tally.combined_body: A failure in either kind, at either stage, fails the act.
vote_tally.combined_fail: The act fails — {which} did not agree {stage}
vote_tally.combined_open: Vote open — both kinds must independently agree {stage}
vote_tally.combined_pass: Both kinds agree {stage} — the act passes
vote_tally.kind_peg_note: peg quorum of this kind: {req} of {serving} serving
vote_tally.kind_yes_of: {yes} yes of {serving} (all serving of this kind)
vote_tally.peg_gloss: Peg quorum: the denominator is every serving seat. An absent member counts the same as a no.
vote_tally.peg_quorum_note: peg quorum: {req} of {serving} serving · Art. II §2
vote_tally.published_hint: Published with your vote · Art. II §2
vote_tally.right_committee: needs {req} of {serving} — all members, not those present · {basis}
vote_tally.tied_broken: Adopted {yes}–{no} — tie broken by the Speaker
